question: Before building this out — is there a written spec for it?
whyHelp:
Here is why this matters right now:
Jumping straight to code on an unscoped feature is the most common source of rework — you build the wrong thing well.
A few lines of spec now saves a rebuild later.

L1.title: Write what "done" looks like before continuing
L1.body: Before continuing, write 3-5 bullet points describing what this feature does from the user's perspective — inputs, outputs, and edge cases. Complete the sentence "this feature is done when..." specifically enough that you could verify it with a single test. Vague done-criteria compound into scope creep.

L2.title: Define done before continuing
L2.body: Write a few bullets on what this feature does — inputs, outputs, edge cases — and finish "this is done when..." before continuing.

L3.title: What does done look like?
L3.body: What does "done" look like here? Write it down first.
